overview.short: Chaman Mahal is a palace in the Bhopal district of Madhya Pradesh, India.
overview.description: Chaman Mahal is a palace in the Bhopal district of Madhya Pradesh, India. It was built by Afghan Commander Dost Mohammad Khan, who was the ruler of Islamnagar in 1715. It is located 11 km away from Bhopal, capital of Madhya Pradesh. 'Chaman' means garden and hence the palace is also known as Garden palace, having an attractive garden in the middle of palace with multiple fountains.

topPlaces.name: Rani Mahal, Islamnagar
topPlaces.distance: 100 m from Chaman Mahal, Madhya Pradesh
topPlaces.description: Situated directly adjacent to Chaman Mahal, Rani Mahal was the queen's royal residence built by Dost Mohammad Khan in 1720. It features beautiful colonnaded stone verandas, inner courtyards, and deep arches blending Malwa and Mughal architectural styles.

image.alt: Rani Mahal royal stone pavilion and arches at Islamnagar

topPlaces.name: Islamnagar Fort Ramparts
topPlaces.distance: 200 m from Chaman Mahal, Madhya Pradesh
topPlaces.description: The fortified bastions and monumental gateways of Islamnagar (formerly Jagdishpur), fortified in 1715 as the first capital of Bhopal's founding dynasty. Offers elevated views across the surrounding countryside and water reservoirs.

image.alt: Islamnagar Fort stone ramparts and watchtowers

topPlaces.name: Kanchbavli Stepped Baoli
topPlaces.distance: 500 m from Chaman Mahal, Madhya Pradesh
topPlaces.description: An ancient stone stepwell (baoli) that provided fresh water to the royal palaces and fountain network of Islamnagar. Features stone staircases and subterranean arched landings showcasing historic water engineering.
topPlaces.travelTime: 5 mins walk / 2 mins drive from Chaman Mahal

image.alt: Kanchbavli historic stone stepwell and reservoir

topPlaces.name: Bhopal Upper Lake (Bhojtal)
topPlaces.distance: 14 km from Chaman Mahal, Madhya Pradesh
topPlaces.description: One of Asia's largest artificial lakes, created by Raja Bhoj in the 11th century. Offers serene sunset boat rides, water promenade walks, and birdwatching along the lush wetlands.

image.alt: Bhopal Upper Lake serene waterfront and horizon

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Chaman Mahal?
